items.titleEn: It's a human attitude that turns the tide. The artist Bakar Bashrachel donates the price of his car to the Hajj , and the Hajj sheikh returns it as a gift .
items.summaryEn: In an all-encompassing humanitarian initiative, Sheikh Abdul Salam Haj returned the artist's car to Bakar Bashar Rahil, after buying it from him and giving it to him again, in appreciation of his human position.
